dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250804-MMR-00](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250804-MMR-00) A flood occurred on Aug 04 2025 in Myanmar. It affected an estimated 1494689 people and 750433 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
